top_apps.name: Piggy Escape
top_apps.description_short: Unscrew the screws, remove the metal plate, and rescue the piglet.
top_apps.description_excerpt:
🐷 Screw Rescue — Match Two, Set Piggy Free! 🐷

Poor little piggy is trapped behind metal plates. Each plate is held in place by two screws. Your mission? Remove every screw and let the pig run free!

🎨 Match the Colors
Tap two screws of the same color, and they disappear together. Get the colors right, and the plates start falling apart. Get it wrong? Those screws stay stuck.

📦 5 Slots for Screws
Under the plates, there are 5 storage slots. When you tap a screw, it moves down into an empty slot, waiting for its matching partner. But if all 5 slots fill up with mismatched screws… you’re stuck. You’ll need to plan carefully and clear pairs before the slots overflow.

🧠 Trickier Every Level
At first, it’s simple — a few plates, clear colors. But as you progress, more colors appear, and the metal plates twist into crazy shapes. Some screws hide behind others. You’ll need sharp eyes and quick thinking to keep the slots from jamming.

⏱️ Race to Save the Pig
No timer, but you can compete with friends — who can rescue the piggy the fastest?

Ready to pull those screws and free the squealing hero? Start matching and save the pig! 🐽🔴🔵🟡🟢💥

Every level begins with a partially revealed layout. You first establish the foundation by placing group cards, then draw new word cards into play and commit them to the right sets. Each placement shapes the board, opening some possibilities while quietly limiting others.

Strategy Over Speed
The challenge in Word Solitaire Go doesn’t come from fast reactions or memorization. It comes from judgment. Should you place a word now, or wait for more information? Should you draw another card, or stabilize what’s already on the table?

top_apps.description_excerpt:
A vertical space shooter defender game.

Core Gameplay。
Control a cyan spaceship in a deep starfield, defending against waves of descending red enemy ships。
Drag anywhere on screen to move your ship and shoot yellow bullets upward to destroy enemies。
Each enemy collision costs a life。

Controls。
Drag gesture to move the ship freely within the lower 65% of the screen。
Reset and Exit buttons available for quick restart or quit。

Enemy Waves。
Red triangular enemies spawn from the top and descend at varying speeds, 4 to 7。
New waves spawn every 55 ticks, with speed and frequency increasing over time for escalating challenge。

Power-ups。
Green orb restores 1 life, max 3 lives。
Yellow orb reduces fire cooldown from 12 to 5 ticks for 180 ticks。

Explosion Effects。
Enemy destruction triggers orange expanding ring particle explosions for satisfying visual feedback。

HUD and Data。
Real-time score, lives, and high score display。
High scores persisted locally via database for competitive replayability。

top_apps.description_excerpt:
aX360e is an Xbox 360 emulator designed for the Android platform, with support currently limited to a selection of games. Actual game performance is dependent on your device's hardware capabilities, and most titles may not run at full speed.

aX360e is ported based on the `arm64-backend` branch of Xenia, the well-known Xbox 360 emulator. It also incorporates most of the code from the xenia-canary project (versions 0.6 and later), with dedicated optimizations tailored for the Android platform.

An open-source plan is in place for this application. You can check the progress of the open-source initiative via the link: https://aenu.cc/ax360e/

> **Note** This application is still under active development and may not be compatible with all your favorite games.

This is the free, ad-supported version of aX360e. You can purchase the ad-free version to support the ongoing development of the emulator.

**Important Notice**: This installation package does not contain any game resources. Please export content from your physical Xbox 360 game discs, convert them to **GOD/ISO format files** for use, or directly load files in the supported formats.
